seoTitle: Douglas County School District Calendar 2028-2029 | Holidays & PDF
seoDescription: See the DCSD 2028-2029 school calendar with the August 9 first day, May 24 last day, 173 student days, breaks, PLC delayed starts, and official PDF.
heroSummary: Douglas County School District begins the 2028-29 conventional school year on Wednesday, August 9, 2028, and the last student day is Thursday, May 24, 2029. The calendar lists 173 student days, Fall Break on October 9-13, Winter Break on December 24-January 5, and Spring Break on March 19-23. The PDF also distinguishes PLC delayed starts from teacher work, professional development, compensation, and district holiday dates.
calendarNotes: The 2028-29 DCSD school calendar lists 173 student days. The first student day is August 9, 2028, and the second semester begins January 9, 2029 after a January 8 teacher work day. Fall Break runs October 9-13. Thanksgiving closure spans November 20-24, with November 22 marked as a compensation day and November 23-24 marked as district holidays. Winter Break runs December 24-January 5, with January 8 reserved for teacher work. Spring Break runs March 19-23, followed by professional development on April 20, a compensation day on April 23, and a teacher work day on May 25.

customSections.label: DCSD Planning Details for 2028-29
customSections.content: This DCSD PDF places several operational dates next to regular attendance days. Families should read the marker before assuming that a colored date is a full closure: PLC means delayed start, while teacher work and professional development mean no students.

rows: Check the school bell schedule and transportation plan for a later arrival.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Douglas County School District start in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: The first student day of the DCSD 2028-29 conventional calendar is Wednesday, August 9, 2028.

calendarFaqs.q: When is DCSD Winter Break in 2028-29?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 24, 2028 through January 5, 2029. January 8 is a teacher work day, and the second semester begins January 9.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of DCSD school in 2029?
calendarFaqs.a: The last student day is Thursday, May 24, 2029. May 25 is marked as a teacher work day.

calendarFaqs.q: Are DCSD PLC days full days off?
calendarFaqs.a: No. PLC Day is labeled as a delayed-start day in the official PDF. Confirm the school-specific start time rather than treating it as a no-school date.

calendarFaqs.q: How many student days are in the DCSD 2028-29 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: The official DCSD calendar identifies 173 all-day student sessions.
